collection.title: Rolls-Royce Wraith 2013 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Rolls Royce Wraith 2013 - 2023 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
